title: Cantar di Gladiel e Mombutu
style: Mediterranean folk ballad, low female voice and male baritone in an intimate Sabir duet, warm and restrained, almost spoken in the verses with whispered ad-libs between lines; a powerful full-voice belt lifts the choruses. Slow 70 BPM minor modal sway, melancholic and dramatic; intimate close-miked sound with warm room tone. Solo oud opens, saz layers in the chorus, distant ney enters, and frame drum shifts from steady pulse to ticking bridge notes; hushed bridge, dramatic build, unresolved ending.
lyrics:
[Intro]
[Instrumental: solo oud, soft frame drum, distant ney]

[Verse 1]
[Female vocal, low, almost spoken]
Fogo grande, notte nero,
Cork star cenere, padre star captivo.
Ella vidir, ella non plorar,
ella dir: "mi non scordar."

[Verse 2]
[Male vocal, warm baritone, restrained]
Ellu star fiu di duca,
ellu non sabir odiar.
Ella star in bentana,
ellu mirar, ellu non parlar.

[Chorus]
[Duet, voices join, oud and saz, frame drum steady]
Amor star catena? Amor star chiave?
Mi non sabir, mi non sabir.
Ti tenir mi, mi tenir ti,
mar andar, mar tornar.

[Verse 3]
[Male vocal]
Ellu andar Perù, ellu tenir sposa,
ma cor star qui, cor non andar.
[Female vocal]
Ella aspettar in casa di nemico,
ella aspettar, ella non sabir perché.

[Verse 4]
[Female vocal, then duet, ney enters]
Francia star freddo, casa star pietra,
ella star sposa, ma anillo star falso.
[Male vocal]
Prete metir aqua, nome vecchio morir,
nome nuovo star porta, nome nuovo star chiave.

[Chorus]
[Duet, fuller, added saz layers]
Amor star catena? Amor star chiave?
Mi non sabir, mi non sabir.
Ti tenir mi, mi tenir ti,
mar andar, mar tornar.

[Bridge]
[Stripped back, ticking pulse, low frame drum, hushed voices]
Imperador dir: "mi dar ti doi mese."
Tre porta star, tuti star mal.
Mi cercar quarta porta,
quarta porta, quarta porta.
